summary.headline: Hanshin Construction wins KRW 76.7bn redevelopment contract in Geumcheon-gu, Seoul
summary.what_happened: Hanshin Construction Co., Ltd. signed a construction contract for the Siheung-dong 859 street-home redevelopment project in Geumcheon-gu, Seoul, with the Siheung 1-dong 859 redevelopment association. The filing is dated Nov 27, 2026, and the contract is paid on a progress-payment basis with no advance payment.
summary.why_it_matters: Large supply or construction contract disclosures in Korea are required when a contract exceeds a set share of a company's revenue, and they give shareholders a view of the order backlog. Contract amounts and periods can change as construction progresses, so the disclosed figures are provisional.
